page_title: MON 2-2 LAZ | Monza v Lazio 04/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' One of the players from Monza times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+6' Giulio Donati (Monza) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
90+6' The game is interrupted. Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
90+5' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Matias Vecino (Lazio) for his blatant foul.

90+2' 2 - 2 A perfect lofted pass from Matteo Pessina finds Milan Djuric (Monza), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the left side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Christos Mandas had no chance of stopping that. 2:2.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
87' The ratio of the ball possession is 58:42.
86' The game has come to an end for Warren Bondo. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Gianluca Caprari (Monza).
83' 1 - 2 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Matias Vecino (Lazio) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 1:2.
82' Igor Tudor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pedro (Lazio) replacing Felipe Anderson.
78' Alessio Zerbin goes off the pitch and Luca Caldirola (Monza) comes on.
75' Referee Luca Pairetto points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Milan Djuric (Monza) goes wild in celebration.
74' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Luca Pairetto is going to take a look using VAR.
73' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Milan Djuric (Monza) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
71' Substitution. Valentin Carboni makes his way off the pitch and Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) comes on as his replacement.
71' That will be all from Georgios Kyriakopoulos who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Dany Mota (Monza).
71' Here is a change. Samuele Birindelli is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Giulio Donati (Monza).
69' The free kick from close range, taken by Monza, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
68' Patric (Lazio) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Pairetto had an easy-decision to make.
65' We are about to witness a substitution. Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) is replacing Luis Alberto.
65' Igor Tudor prepares a substitution. Daichi Kamada is replaced by Matias Vecino (Lazio).
65' The referee signals a substitution. Taty Castellanos (Lazio) is brought on as a substitute for Ciro Immobile.
62' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Monza will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
62' Andrea Colpani (Monza) sends a chip pass into the box, but Christos Mandas is quickest to intercept the ball.
59' The Lazio players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
57' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Monza, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) was quite harsh and Luca Pairetto didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
53' Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Good clearance! Felipe Anderson (Lazio) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
52' The total number of attempts is 8:6.
48' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Luca Pairetto has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) has tested the patience of referee Luca Pairetto and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
41' The ball goes out for a corner. Lazio can continue in their attacking effort.
41' The ball is cleared after Ciro Immobile (Lazio) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

39' Warren Bondo (Monza) has a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better as his effort ends wide of the left post.
38' Luis Alberto (Lazio) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
35' Monza are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
35' Nicolo Casale (Lazio) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
34' Valentin Carboni (Monza) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
33' Monza have a corner.
32' A substitution has been made. Mattia Zaccagni goes off and Nicolo Casale (Lazio) comes on.

27' Excellent touch by Ciro Immobile (Lazio)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
26' The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
26' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
24' A quickly taken corner by Lazio.
23' Great ball in from Andrea Colpani. Valentin Carboni (Monza) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the right post.
20' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It's a throw-in for Lazio.
16' Monza are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
15' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
14' Monza force a corner. They send men into the box.
11' 0 - 1 Goal! Ciro Immobile (Lazio) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
11' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) fires a low volley towards the left side of the goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save.
9' Andrea Colpani (Monza) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Christos Mandas was alert and made a comfortable save.
8' A player from Monza commits a rough challenge. Luca Pairetto blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
7' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
4' Luis Alberto (Lazio) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
2' Luis Alberto (Lazio) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Monza will kick-off.
